<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"/><title>Reference-Traced Demon</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#000;color:#d8c7c4;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}#app{position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 47%,#0b0101 0%,#030000 45%,#000 82%)}canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}#loading{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#000;color:#75382f;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;transition:opacity .35s}#hud{position:fixed;left:18px;top:16px;z-index:5;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,70,40,.14);background:rgba(4,0,0,.36);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;user-select:none;transition:opacity .2s}#hud b{display:block;color:#ff6d54;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:3px}#phase{color:#c9a19b;min-width:245px}.bar{width:245px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin:7px 0 6px;overflow:hidden}.bar i{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#590804,#ff3d21,#ffd3c2)}#clock{color:#80635f;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.buttons{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:7px}button{border:1px solid rgba(255,75,45,.18);background:rgba(22,3,2,.72);color:#b89a94;padding:4px 7px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}#hint{opacity:.38;font-size:9px;margin-top:5px}#vignette{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%,transparent 39%,rgba(0,0,0,.18) 62%,rgba(0,0,0,.84) 100%)}#flash{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3;opacity:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%,rgba(255,55,28,.24),rgba(65,0,0,.05) 35%,transparent 70%)}@media(max-width:700px){#hud{left:10px;top:10px;transform:scale(.86);transform-origin:top left}}</style>
